requirements.statement: An employee can submit an expense claim with amount, category, date, description, and a receipt attachment

criteria.must: An employee can submit a claim with amount, category, date, description, and a receipt attachment
A submitted claim starts in pending status
Submitting a claim without a required field is rejected

requirements.statement: An employee can view the status of their submitted claims

criteria.must: An employee can see a list of their own submitted claims with each claim's current status
A claim's status is one of pending, approved, or rejected

requirements.statement: An employee can edit or withdraw a claim while it is still pending

criteria.must: An employee can edit the details of a claim that is still pending
An employee can withdraw a claim that is still pending
An employee cannot edit or withdraw a claim that has already been approved or rejected

requirements.statement: An employee can see why a claim was rejected and resubmit a corrected version

criteria.must: An employee can view the rejection reason on a rejected claim
An employee can edit a rejected claim and resubmit it, returning it to pending status

requirements.statement: A manager can see a queue of pending claims submitted by their direct reports

criteria.must: A manager sees only pending claims submitted by employees who report to them
A manager does not see pending claims submitted by employees who do not report to them

requirements.statement: A manager can approve a pending claim

criteria.must: A manager can approve a pending claim submitted by one of their reports
An approved claim's status changes to approved

requirements.statement: A manager can reject a pending claim with a reason

criteria.must: A manager can reject a pending claim and must supply a reason
A rejected claim's status changes to rejected and stores the given reason

requirements.statement: Finance can view all approved claims across the organization

criteria.must: Finance can view a list of all approved claims regardless of which manager approved them

requirements.statement: Finance can export approved claims as a downloadable CSV file for payroll

criteria.must: Finance can trigger an export that produces a downloadable CSV file of approved claims
The exported CSV contains the claim data needed for payroll processing

requirements.statement: Exported claims are marked as exported so they are not exported twice

criteria.must: A claim included in an export is marked as exported
A subsequent export does not include a claim already marked as exported
